title: Motion logo reveal
caption: The motion-logo-reveal recipe: a dot sparks into a brand-coloured line, the logo springs up from behind it, a ring pulse marks the landing and the tagline settles in below.
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to make a 4 second 16:9 logo sting for Magnifito, a Bulgarian digital marketing agency, in the motion-logo-reveal style only: our logo (assets/magnifito-logo.svg) rises from a brand-coloured line, with the tagline "Digital marketing with heart and value." below. Use the motion engine. Brand colours are warm browns on cream (#7a584c, #ae8c72, #f0eadf), Geist for type, English on screen.
